jobs.title: AI and Technical Learning Manager
jobs.description: Trust Centre Trust Centre Trust Centre How Trustpilot works Trust report 2025 Trustpilot’s use of AI Public affairs Public affairs Investors For investors Investor Relations Why invest in Trustpilot Results, reports and presentations IR Newsletter Regulatory news Analyst coverage Analyst consensus Sustainability Financial calendar IPO information Shareholder information Shareholder FAQs Shareholder meetings and documents Share price center Governance Board and executive teams Anti bribery policy Modern slavery policy Code of ethics Articles of association Terms of reference Schedule of matters reserved for the board PwC Statement of Reasons Legal Guidelines and policies Our guidelines and policies For reviewers For businesses For everyone Press Global announcements Press Brand hub Press contact Careers Working at Trustpilot Careers at Trustpilot Open jobs DEI at Trustpilot Company About Trustpilot Trustpilot for Consumers Trustpilot for Business Trustpilot Data Solutions Contact us Menu Close Trust Centre Investors Legal Press Careers Company Contact us AI and Technical Learning Manager London At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust! As our AI and Technical Learning Manager, you are the architect of Trustpilot’s AI-first culture. Your primary mission is to build the confidence, curiosity, and capability our people need to work with AI in meaningful and practical ways. You will design the strategy that embeds AI into how Trusties think and work, shifting our culture from one that talks about AI to one that uses it every day. Alongside this, you will ensure our people have the technical skills they need to do their jobs brilliantly, whether that is through Tech Academies, apprenticeship-funded programmes, or bespoke functional upskilling in our Technology teams. Your success is measured by your ability to move the dial on technical proficiency, AI confidence, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. What you'll be doing: Drive AI adoption across Trustpilot. This is the core of your role. You will design and run the initiatives, campaigns, and learning experiences that shift how Trusties think about and use AI in their day-to-day work. The goal is practical, confident, widespread adoption. Build an AI learning strategy that goes beyond awareness. You will create a structured approach to AI capability building that moves people from curiosity to fluency. That means understanding where Trusties are starting from, what good looks like, and how to get them there quickly and confidently. Consult with functional leaders on AI use cases. You will work alongside leaders across the business to identify where AI and new tools can genuinely change how their teams work. You will then design the learning and change support to make those shifts happen. Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous learning. You will create the conditions where Trusties feel safe to explore, try things out, and build their own efficiencies with technology. This is about mindset as much as skills. Design and oversee technical skills programmes. Supporting the AI agenda, you will also ensure Trusties have access to strong technical skills development, including through Tech Academies and other structured learning pathways that build deep functional capability in our technology teams. Make the most of Apprenticeship Levy funding. You will manage and deploy the Apprenticeship Levy strategically, ensuring eligible Trusties can access high-quality, formally accredited training in AI, technology, and data. Measure adoption, confidence, and impact. You will define the metrics that matter, track them consistently, and give leadership a clear picture of how AI capability is developing across the business. Data will inform every iteration of your strategy. Keep Trustpilot at the leading edge. You will benchmark our AI and technical learning maturity against industry standards, bring in emerging best practices, and make sure our strategy evolves as the landscape does. Who you are: Passionate about AI and how it changes the way people work. You have hands-on experience driving AI adoption and digital transformation. You understand the technology, but more importantly, you understand people and how to bring them on the journey. A strategic architect, not just a programme manager. You build systems and frameworks that create lasting change. You have a track record of designing and deploying learning and adoption strategies that result in real, measurable shifts in how people work. Technically fluent. You are deeply comfortable in the current AI landscape, including Generative AI and LLMs. You can hold a credible conversation with Product and Tech leaders and translate complex concepts into accessible learning. A skilled change manager. You understand that learning alone does not change behaviour. You know how to address resistance, build confidence, and design adoption journeys that account for the human side of change. Experienced in technical capability building. You have designed and delivered technical skills programmes, including managing Tech Academy-style frameworks, and you know how to build functional capability at scale. Savvy with Apprenticeship Levy funding. You understand how to use Levy funding strategically to accelerate skills development in technology and AI, and you can navigate the requirements to maximise its value. A confident stakeholder consultant. You can influence senior leaders, earn their trust quickly, and position AI and technical learning as a genuine business priority rather than a nice-to-have. Data-driven in how you work. You track adoption, expertise, and ROI. You use evidence to make decisions, tell the story of impact clearly, and continuously improve what you build. What's in it for you: A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you Competitive compensation package + bonus 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist Pension and life insurance Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7, Employee Assistance Plan Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health Paid parental leave Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme Central office location complete with table tennis, a gaming corner, coffee bars and all the snacks and refreshments you can ask for Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials. Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more. Independent financial advice and free standard professional mortgage broker advice Talent acceleration programs: Fast-track your career with our tailored development programs designed to support growth at whatever stage of your career Still not sure? We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you! #LI-Hybrid #LI-RS1 About us Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve. Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go. Join us at the heart of trust. Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust. Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy. If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.
